about: The flows compare-mobile measures, the same for every app (cmux, Claude, Codex and the other chat apps in cmux-design-references). Each flow is one clip that starts idle, gets one stimulus, and ends settled. `stimulus` is the input the driver sends; `response` is the first frame the measure counts as the app answering; `region` is where the answer shows (fractions of the screen: top, bottom), used to find the response and the moving edge whose curve is fitted. A driver writes meta.json next to clip.mp4 (see README.md); measure.py reads both.

flows.title: Cold launch to typing
flows.response: first frame of the app's own UI
flows.settle: the composer is focused and the caret shows

flows.title: Send to first token
flows.stimulus: tap send on a one-line prompt
flows.response: first assistant text in the transcript
flows.settle: the first token is drawn (the clip may end before the answer does)

flows.title: Streaming a long answer
flows.stimulus: send a prompt with a long answer

flows.title: Fling a long chat
flows.stimulus: one fast upward swipe on a long transcript

flows.title: Scroll to bottom
flows.settle: the last message rests above the composer

flows.title: Keyboard hides
flows.stimulus: swipe the transcript down, or tap outside

flows.title: Composer grows
flows.stimulus: type past the first line, then several lines

flows.title: Attach an image
flows.stimulus: tap attach, pick the first photo
flows.response: first frame a picker or sheet appears
flows.settle: the thumbnail rests in the composer

flows.title: Switch chats
flows.settle: the other chat's transcript is still

flows.title: Sidebar or history opens
flows.stimulus: tap the sidebar or history button

flows.title: Voice mode starts
flows.settle: the voice UI is still or idles in its loop

flows.title: Offline error
flows.response: first frame the app shows it failed or is offline
